text:
ana: throwing this up for design review — proposal to add a thin "annotation lane" above the heatmap to show notable outlier events (deploys, config changes) and a compact sampler preview that overlays a few sampled traces on hover. thinking it helps explain sudden p95 jumps instead of just the spike

mike: love the idea. two quick asks: 1) can the lane be collapsible by default? 2) keyboard shortcut to toggle the timepicker (so power users can quickly expand range) — maybe `t`? :keyboard:

sara: accessibility nit first: if we add another visual layer we must maintain 3:1 contrast for the lane icons/text and ensure the heatmap color ramp has numeric legends for screen readers. propose adding visually-hidden labels like `aria-label="Heatmap p95 color: 250ms"` and an `aria-live` region for percentile updates

lex: for the sampler preview micro-interaction — instead of full traces, show 3 tiny sparklines aligned to the heatmap buckets + an estimated delta preview (e.g., “p95 +12ms if sampled”). UI snippet idea:

```\n// on hover: fetchSamplerPreview(range, buckets=3)\nrenderPreview([sparkline1, sparkline2, sparkline3])\nshowBadge("est p95 Δ: +12ms")\n```

kevin: implementation note — try to keep sampler preview client-side and capped to N=3 to avoid extra infra costs. we can lazy-load the preview data when the lane/preview is first opened. also prefer debounce 300ms on hover to avoid floods

jamie: copy tweak suggestion for the compact mode toggle: change label from "Compact" to "Compact (low density)" — makes it clearer what it does for non-designers. also default new accounts to compact off, most teams prefer density on first try :eyes:

ana: oops typo, meant "ana" above — UX question: do we align bucket edges to local timezone or keep UTC? aligning to local time helps product teams correlate deploys with business hours, but UTC simplifies backend aggregation

mike: +1 for local alignment as a user preference. default to UTC for consistency, but expose a quick toggle in the timepicker header: `Timezone: UTC ▾`

sara: color ramp suggestion — current purple->red ramp fails some deuteranopia checks. try a blue->amber ramp and add numeric ticks: `0ms, 100ms, 250ms, 500ms` — also add a setting to switch to monotone high-contrast for a11y

lex: UX edge-case: when user selects a custom time range, keep the annotation lane anchored to absolute time (don't resample annotations). otherwise annotations jump around and story context is lost

kevin: for rollout, let's gate the annotation lane behind a feature flag + telemetry event `annotation_lane_opened` so we can measure usage before enabling by default

dev-bot: deploy-preview available at https://staging-console.redwood-inference.com/heatmap-annotations (expires in 3 days) :rocket:

ana: thanks everyone — I'll put these notes into the Figma file (link in thread) and add a small acceptance checklist: 1) keyboard shortcut doc, 2) aria-live for percentile changes, 3) sampler debounce, 4) color ramp a11y test, 5) feature-flag telemetry. will follow up with mocks later this week :thumbsup:
